title: Woodland Scene 5 — Woodland Homes
purpose: Talk about where woodland animals live, rest or store food.

sentenceModels: The owl is in the tree hollow.
The squirrel is putting an acorn into the stump.
The rabbit is going into the burrow.
The fox is resting in the den.
The hedgehog is near the leaves.

adultSupport.focus: Prompt 'where' questions and simple home-related inference.
starterPrompts: Which animal is in the den?
Which animal is near the leaf pile?
expansionPrompts: Who lives in a hole in the tree?
Can you tell me which animal is by the water?

visualAudit: Owl sitting inside a tree hollow.
Squirrel storing acorns in a stump.
Fox resting in a root den.
Hedgehog near a leaf pile and deer by the water.
